Bhakti and Regional Traditions

The Kural

Or the Maxims of Tiruvaḷḷuvar

Tiruvaḷḷuvar; translated by V. V. S. Aiyar

The 1,330 couplets of the Tamil Tirukkuṟaḷ on virtue, wealth and love, in the English prose of the scholar and patriot V. V. S. Aiyar (1916).

docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
An English translation of the Tirukkuṟaḷ, chapter by chapter, made by V. V. S. Aiyar (1881–1925), Tamil scholar and freedom fighter, while in exile in Pondicherry, and published at Madras in 1916 with his preface and notes. The Tamil text is on the shelf Classic Texts.

From Wikisource · Public domain

The Kural or the Maxims of Tiruvalluvar, translated by V. V. S. Aiyar (1881–1925), Madras, 1916, as validated on English Wikisource by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikisource when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: Public domain. Modified: converted to this format.
